Ok I stand corrected

It seems stray RF accidentally using the wire of your headphone as an antenna ending up in your head was the case some years ago but not anymore

They fixed it by spreading the antenna around the frame of the phone, TIL! https://t.co/9Rff0io36L https://t.co/5wizr8Jeqs
posts.text_zh:
好吧，我收回之前的说法

看起来，杂散射频（RF）偶尔把耳机线当成天线、最终进入你头部的情况，几年前确实有过，但现在已经不是这样了

他们的修法是把天线分散布置在手机边框周围，今天才知道（TIL）！https://t.co/9Rff0io36L https://t.co/5wizr8Jeqs

Okay it works, I can now upload a video or some photos or just a floor plan of my living room

And then:
- empty it fully
- move around furniture
- remove furniture
- paint the walls, floor, ceiling and any object in any color

Next:
- top down floor plan view
- change to any interior design style with one-click
- integrate it into 🏡 Interior AI fully as a feature

Very very very cool 😍🤟
quoted.text_zh:
好了，搞定了。我现在可以把客厅的一段视频、几张照片，或者只是一张平面图上传上去

然后就可以：
- 把房间完全清空
- 来回移动家具
- 移除家具
- 把墙面、地板、天花板和任何物体涂成任意颜色

接下来还要做：
- 俯视平面图视角
- 一键换成任意室内设计风格
- 把它完整集成进 🏡 Interior AI，作为一项功能

非常非常非常酷 😍🤟

posts.text:
⏰ 3 hours later I have it working as a feature!

Real video-to-3d with my own built headless Blender on a VPS

You can upload a walkthrough video of your living room or entire floor

Interior AI turns it into a walkable 3d space where you can paint your walls, move everything around and get a floor plan

It's a quick prototype but it works!

LIVE now on 🏡 Interior AI for all users 😊 🙏 

Thanks @wesbos for a lot of the inspiration here too
posts.text_zh:
⏰ 3 小时后，我已经把它做成功能跑起来了！

真正的 video-to-3d，用的是我自己在 VPS 上搭建的无头 Blender

你可以上传客厅或整层楼的走查视频

Interior AI 会把它变成一个可走动的 3D 空间，你可以粉刷墙壁、移动所有东西，还能得到平面图

这是个快速原型，但确实能用！

现已在 🏡 Interior AI 上对所有用户 LIVE 上线 😊 🙏 

也感谢 @wesbos 给了很多灵感

引用内容：他引用了自己稍早那条「搞定了」的 Interior AI 帖子：现在可以上传客厅视频、照片或平面图，清空房间、移动/移除家具，并把墙面、地板、天花板和任何物体涂成任意颜色；接下来还要做俯视平面图、一键换风格，并完整集成进 🏡 Interior AI。

The IKEA effect is one of the more useful ideas in startups.

People value things up to 63% more when they helped build them (think Spotify playlists, Notion workspaces, Obsidian vaults). https://t.co/CpREoJfDx9
posts.text_zh:
「宜家效应」（IKEA effect）是创业里比较有用的想法之一。

当人们参与了某样东西的搭建，会把它的价值看得高出最多 63%（比如 Spotify 播放列表、Notion 工作区、Obsidian 仓库）。https://t.co/CpREoJfDx9
